content.title: BWX (NYSE:BWXT) Reports Strong Q3
content.summary: Aerospace and defense company BWX (NYSE:BWXT) reported revenue ahead of Wall Streets expectations in Q3 CY2025, with sales up 28.9% year on year to $866.3 million. Its non-GAAP profit of $1 per share was 16.5% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
